Dated manifests for Albums 8–20 come from Windows folder screenshots supplied directly by Tim Dooley on 4 October 2026; Album 8 also has separately archived media masters.
Folder-list order is provenance order, not automatically an album track sequence. Creation timestamps are preserved separately so readers can sort chronologically without inventing sequence.
Albums 4–7 have not yet been supplied in this recovery pass.
Heavy media masters remain outside the GitHub Pages repository. Public playback links stay empty until exact stable publication URLs are recovered or supplied.
